title: Novice Trade: Apple
text:
Mark Sebastian | Jul 31, 2018 | 2:07 PM EDT
Ahead of earnings Tuesday tonight, Apple (AAPL) is pricing in an Aug. 3 weekly at-the-money straddle price of about $8.20. The straddle, you'll remember, is the market's best guess of how much the underlying stock might move on earnings.
While that might sound like a big number, at about 4.25%, it's actually one of the cheapest prices we have seen in a while. Think about that, days after Alphabet (GOOGL) exploded higher, Facebook (FB) got torched for 20%, Amazon (AMZN) gave away more than 5% off the top, Netflix (NFLX) lost big, and Microsoft (MSFT) blew the doors off, the biggest company in the world has a straddle that is, as a percentage, one of the lowest in recent earnings cycles.
